weight_loss.label: Weight loss
weight_loss.description: Higher-protein meals that make a lower calorie target easier to manage.

meals.name: Egg White & Veggie Scramble
walmart: Great Value 100% Liquid Egg Whites (32oz carton)
Birds Eye Steamfresh Mixed Peppers & Onions (10oz)
meals.steps: Microwave veggies 3 min. Pour ¾ cup egg whites into a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add drained veggies, scramble until set. Top with 2 tbsp shredded cheese.
meals.tip: Liquid egg whites save time and are virtually zero fat. One bag of frozen peppers gives you 4-5 breakfast servings.

meals.name: Chobani Zero Sugar Protein Bowl
walmart: Chobani Zero Sugar Plain Greek Yogurt (5.3oz)
meals.steps: Thaw ½ cup berries in microwave 60 sec. Top yogurt with berries and granola.
meals.tip: Chobani Zero Sugar has 15g protein with 0g sugar - one of the best cutting breakfast options.

meals.name: Dave's Killer Toast with Turkey
walmart: Dave's Killer Bread 21 Whole Grains (1 slice)
Philadelphia 1/3 Less Fat Cream Cheese (2 tbsp)
meals.steps: Toast bread. Spread cream cheese, layer turkey and tomato slices.
meals.tip: Dave's bread has 5g protein per slice - more than most breads. Add a sprinkle of everything bagel seasoning for extra flavor.

meals.name: Premier Protein Pancakes
walmart: Kodiak Cakes Power Cakes Mix (2/3 cup dry)
meals.steps: Mix Kodiak mix with 1 egg and the Premier Protein shake (use as the liquid). Cook on griddle over medium heat, 2-3 min per side.
meals.tip: This swap replaces all the water/milk in Kodiak cakes with a protein shake, doubling the protein content.

meals.name: Kirkland Egg White Bites
walmart: Kirkland Signature Egg Bites (Costco, 1 serving = 2 bites)
meals.steps: Microwave egg bites 60-90 seconds per package instructions. Serve with salsa.
meals.tip: Costco sells these in 24-count packs at about $0.75 per pair - the cheapest high-protein grab-and-go breakfast available.

meals.name: Siggi's Skyr with Chia & Almond Butter
meals.steps: Mix chia seeds into skyr, drizzle almond butter on top.
meals.tip: Siggi's has nearly twice the protein of regular yogurt. Chia seeds add fiber that keeps you full for hours.

meals.name: Tuna Lettuce Wraps
meals.steps: Mix tuna with mayo and diced celery. Scoop into romaine leaves. Top with salsa.
meals.tip: Tuna pouches are the best protein-per-dollar food in the store - 22g protein for under $1.50.

meals.name: Trader Joe's Protein Bowl
walmart: TJ's Grilled Chicken Strips (from frozen section, 3oz)
TJ's Harvest Grains Blend (1/2 cup cooked)
meals.steps: Microwave chicken and grains. Toss with raw Cruciferous Crunch. Drizzle dressing.
meals.tip: Trader Joe's Harvest Grains Blend is a mix of Israeli couscous, red quinoa, and orzo - more interesting than plain rice.

meals.name: Costco Chicken Breast Meal Prep
walmart: Kirkland Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (buy in bulk, use 5oz per serving)
Kirkland Organic Brown Rice Pouches (microwave, 1/2 pouch)
meals.steps: Season chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder. Bake at 400°F 22 min. Microwave rice pouch and broccoli. Meal prep 4 servings at once.
meals.tip: Costco chicken breast is usually $3.50/lb - the cheapest source of quality protein. Prep Sunday, eat Mon-Thu.

meals.name: Good & Gather Salad Kit + Chicken
walmart: Good & Gather Asian Chopped Salad Kit (Target)
meals.steps: Prepare salad kit per package. Top with grilled chicken strips.
meals.tip: Target Good & Gather salad kits come with dressing and toppings already included - zero prep beyond opening the bag.

meals.name: Whole Foods Hot Bar Protein Bowl
walmart: Whole Foods Hot Bar: Grilled Salmon or Rotisserie Chicken (4oz)
Whole Foods Hot Bar: Roasted Vegetables (1/2 cup)
Whole Foods Prepared: Wild Rice Pilaf (1/2 cup)
meals.steps: Pick your protein, vegetables, and grain from the hot bar. Done.
meals.tip: The Whole Foods hot bar charges by weight - fill with high-protein, low-carb items like grilled fish and roasted veggies for best value.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Lemon Herb Salmon
walmart: Kirkland Wild Alaskan Sockeye Salmon (Costco, 5oz fillet)
meals.steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Place salmon and asparagus on sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil, lemon, minced garlic. Roast 15-18 min.
meals.tip: Costco sells 3lb bags of individually portioned wild salmon - thaw what you need, keep the rest frozen for $7-9/lb.

meals.name: Trader Joe's Turkey Meatball Bowl
meals.steps: Cook cauliflower gnocchi in skillet per package. Warm meatballs and marinara. Combine, top with cheese.
meals.tip: TJ's cauliflower gnocchi cuts carbs in half vs regular pasta gnocchi. The turkey meatballs are 6g protein each.

meals.name: Ground Turkey Stuffed Peppers
walmart: Great Value Instant Brown Rice (1/2 cup dry)
Kraft Mexican Blend Shredded Cheese (1/4 cup)
meals.steps: Cook turkey with taco seasoning. Mix with cooked rice and half the tomato sauce. Halve peppers, remove seeds, fill with turkey mixture. Top with cheese. Bake 400°F 20 min.
meals.tip: Make 6 pepper halves at once - the leftovers reheat perfectly for lunch the next 2 days.

meals.name: Banza Chickpea Pasta with Turkey
walmart: Banza Chickpea Penne (2oz dry = ~1 cup cooked)
meals.steps: Cook Banza pasta per package (slightly al dente). Brown turkey with garlic. Add marinara and spinach until wilted. Toss with pasta.
meals.tip: Banza pasta has 14g protein per serving vs 7g for regular pasta. Combined with turkey this is 44g protein in a bowl that feels like comfort food.

meals.name: Quest Bar + Apple
walmart: Quest Bar (any flavor, Walmart or Target)
meals.steps: Grab and go.
meals.tip: Quest bars have 14g fiber which slows digestion and keeps you full on a cut. The apple adds natural sugar for energy.

meals.name: Cottage Cheese & Veggie Plate
walmart: Trader Joe's Everything But the Bagel Seasoning (or Walmart store brand)
meals.steps: Slice cucumber. Arrange with carrots and cottage cheese on a plate. Shake seasoning on cottage cheese.
meals.tip: Cottage cheese is one of the highest protein-per-calorie dairy foods available. 13g protein for 90 calories.

meals.name: RX Bar + String Cheese
walmart: RX Bar Chocolate Sea Salt (Target or Whole Foods)
meals.steps: Eat both.
meals.tip: RX Bars have zero grams of added sugar - all sweetness comes from dates. String cheese adds easy protein and fat.

meals.name: Kirkland Protein Bar
walmart: Kirkland Signature Protein Bar (Costco, any flavor)
meals.steps: Open and eat.
meals.tip: Costco protein bars are $1.10 each vs $2.50+ at stores - same macros as Quest or ONE bars. Best value protein bar available.

muscle_gain.label: Muscle gain
muscle_gain.description: Substantial meals with enough protein and energy to support a gaining phase.

meals.name: Kodiak Power Waffles with Nut Butter
walmart: Kodiak Cakes Power Waffles Frozen (2 waffles)
Kirkland 100% Pure Maple Syrup (1 tbsp, optional)
meals.steps: Toast Kodiak waffles. Top with almond butter, sliced banana, and maple syrup.
meals.tip: Kodiak waffles have 14g protein for 2 waffles before any toppings. This is one of the best-tasting bulking breakfasts.

meals.name: 5-Egg Breakfast Scramble
walmart: Vital Farms Pasture Raised Eggs (Costco or WFM, 3 whole)
Egg Whites from carton (2 whites extra)
meals.steps: Scramble 3 whole eggs + 2 egg whites together. Cook on medium with butter. Add cheese at the end. Serve with sliced avocado and toast.
meals.tip: Whole eggs contain cholesterol and fat - both needed for testosterone production. Don't skip the yolks when bulking.

meals.name: Mass Builder Smoothie
walmart: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard Whey Chocolate (1 scoop)
Quaker Old Fashioned Oats (1/2 cup dry)
meals.steps: Blend everything together on high 45 seconds.
meals.tip: This is approximately 700+ calories in one glass. For hard gainers who struggle to eat enough, this is the answer.

meals.name: Overnight Oats Mass Build
walmart: Kirkland Organic Rolled Oats (1 cup dry)
Trader Joe's Peanut Butter Granola (1/4 cup topping)
meals.steps: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, honey, and chia in a mason jar. Stir well. Refrigerate overnight. Add granola topping in the morning.
meals.tip: Prep 5 jars on Sunday. Your entire week of bulking breakfasts is done in 20 minutes.

meals.name: Costco Rotisserie Chicken Rice Bowl
walmart: Costco Rotisserie Chicken (2 cups pulled, white + dark)
Kirkland Organic Brown Rice Pouches (1 full pouch)
meals.steps: Microwave rice pouch 90 sec. Shred rotisserie chicken. Combine in bowl with sliced avocado, salsa, and lime squeeze.
meals.tip: Costco's $5 rotisserie chicken provides 5-6 meals. The dark meat adds healthy fat for bulking. Best calorie-to-dollar ratio in the store.

meals.name: Trader Joe's Burrito Bowl Build
walmart: TJ's Organic Black Beans (1/2 cup, canned)
TJ's Frozen Brown Rice (1 cup, microwaved)
TJ's Corn & Chile Tomato-less Salsa (3 tbsp)
meals.steps: Warm chicken, beans, and rice separately (microwave). Assemble in bowl with salsa, cheese, and guac on top.
meals.tip: Trader Joe's has every component of this bowl pre-made and ready in under 15 min. Their guacamole in individual cups is the cleanest ingredient list available.

meals.name: Big Muscle Mac & Cheese Bowl
walmart: Great Value Frozen Broccoli Florets (1 cup)
meals.steps: Cook Banza mac per box. Brown turkey in a pan. Microwave broccoli 3 min. Mix everything in one bowl with parmesan.
meals.tip: Banza mac has 26g protein per box before adding turkey. This hits 50g protein while feeling like comfort food.

meals.name: Whole Foods Grain Bowl
walmart: WFM Hot Bar: Grilled Chicken or Salmon (5oz)
WFM Prepared Foods: Farro or Wild Rice (3/4 cup)
WFM Hot Bar: Roasted Root Vegetables (1/2 cup)
WFM Salad Bar: Sunflower Seeds (1 tbsp)
meals.steps: Build your bowl from the hot bar and prepared foods section.
meals.tip: Ask the hot bar staff for the highest-protein options. Salmon, whole grain farro, and roasted veggies is a textbook bulking meal.

meals.name: Ground Beef & Sweet Potato Power Meal
meals.steps: Microwave sweet potatoes 8 min until soft. Brown ground beef with spices. Split potatoes open, top with beef, cheese, sour cream, and green onion.
meals.tip: Sweet potatoes digest slowly - better pre-workout energy than white rice. 80/20 beef adds the healthy fats needed during a bulk.

meals.name: Costco Salmon Pasta
walmart: Kirkland Extra Virgin Olive Oil (2 tbsp)
meals.steps: Cook pasta. Season and pan-sear salmon 4 min per side. Wilt spinach and tomatoes in olive oil with garlic in the same pan. Toss with pasta, flake salmon over the top.
meals.tip: Barilla Protein+ has 10g protein per serving vs 7g regular pasta. Kirkland olive oil is highest quality for a low price.

meals.name: Trader Joe's Steak & Rice Bowl
walmart: TJ's Fully Cooked Beef Sirloin (or marinate TJ's Sirloin Steak Tips)
TJ's Frozen Jasmine Rice (1.5 cups cooked)
meals.steps: Cook steak per instructions. Microwave rice. Roast asparagus at 425°F 12 min. Assemble bowl with Soyaki drizzle and sesame seeds.
meals.tip: TJ's Soyaki is their best-selling sauce - teriyaki-style with just 8 ingredients. Transforms plain steak into a restaurant-quality meal.

meals.name: Mass Gainer Shake
walmart: ON Gold Standard Whey Chocolate (1 scoop)
meals.steps: Blend all together until smooth.
meals.tip: This is a real mass gainer shake - 740 calories in one glass. Cheaper and cleaner than any store-bought mass gainer.

meals.name: Greek Yogurt Bark (Freezer Snack)
meals.steps: Mix honey into yogurt. Spread onto parchment-lined baking sheet (1/2 inch thick). Top with berries and chocolate chips. Freeze 2+ hours. Break into pieces.
meals.tip: Make one batch Sunday, gives you 3-4 snacks throughout the week. High protein, feels like dessert.

meals.name: Kirkland Mixed Nuts + Jerky
meals.steps: Open bags, eat.
meals.tip: Costco sells their mixed nuts and jerky in bulk at about half the price of grocery stores. A perfect high-calorie, high-protein portable snack.

maintenance.label: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Balanced meals for steady intake without pushing calories in either direction.

meals.name: Avocado Toast with Eggs
walmart: Vital Farms Eggs (2 poached or fried)
Trader Joe's Everything But the Bagel Seasoning
meals.steps: Toast bread. Mash avocado with lemon, salt. Spread on toast. Add eggs. Season with EBtB and red pepper.
meals.tip: The Everything But the Bagel seasoning from Trader Joe's is the secret to making avocado toast actually taste good. $2 for a jar that lasts months.

meals.name: Bob's Red Mill Overnight Oats
walmart: Bob's Red Mill Organic Old Fashioned Oats (1/2 cup)
Almond Breeze Unsweetened Almond Milk (1 cup)
Kind Dark Chocolate Nuts & Sea Salt (1/2 bar, crumbled)
meals.steps: Mix oats, almond milk, yogurt in jar. Refrigerate overnight. Top with berries and crumbled Kind bar before eating.
meals.tip: Bob's Red Mill oats are available everywhere and certified gluten-free. The Kind bar topping adds crunch without a lot of sugar.

meals.name: Target Good & Gather Smoothie Bowl
walmart: Good & Gather Organic Acai Smoothie Packs (Target)
meals.steps: Blend acai pack with almond milk and mango until thick. Pour in bowl, top with granola and banana.
meals.tip: Keep the liquid minimal - you want a thick, spoonable texture, not a drinkable smoothie.

meals.name: Whole Foods Poke Bowl
walmart: WFM Sushi Bar: Ahi Tuna Poke (4oz)
WFM Prepared Foods: Sushi Rice (3/4 cup)
WFM Salad Bar: Shredded Carrots, Cucumber, Edamame (1/2 cup total)
WFM: Nori sheets or Crispy Onions (topping)
meals.steps: Build your bowl with rice on the bottom, poke and veggies on top, drizzle dressing.
meals.tip: Whole Foods makes fresh poke daily. Cheaper than a restaurant poke bowl with the same quality.

meals.name: Trader Joe's Mediterranean Plate
meals.steps: Warm falafel per package (oven 375°F 15 min). Warm pita. Plate with hummus, tzatziki, cucumber, and tomatoes.
meals.tip: TJ's frozen falafel is shockingly good - crispy on the outside, fluffy inside. This whole meal costs about $5.

meals.name: Costco Quinoa Salad with Chicken
walmart: Costco Ready Pac Bistro Salad or Pre-Made Quinoa Salad (1 container)
Kirkland Extra Virgin Olive Oil (1 tsp drizzle)
meals.steps: Combine rotisserie chicken with the pre-made quinoa salad.
meals.tip: Costco sells pre-made quinoa salads in the refrigerated section. Combined with their $5 rotisserie chicken this takes 3 minutes to prepare.

meals.name: Trader Joe's Chicken Tikka Masala
walmart: TJ's Chicken Tikka Masala (1 box, frozen or refrigerated)
TJ's Frozen Brown Rice (1 cup cooked)
TJ's Baby Spinach (1 cup, stirred in)
meals.steps: Heat tikka masala per package. Microwave rice. Add spinach to the hot curry to wilt. Serve over rice.
meals.tip: TJ's Chicken Tikka Masala is one of the highest-rated frozen meals on the market. Adding spinach boosts iron and nutrients without changing the taste.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Chicken & Veggies
walmart: Kirkland Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs (5oz, Costco)
meals.steps: Preheat oven 425°F. Toss everything in avocado oil spray and seasoning on one large sheet pan. Roast 25-28 min, flipping halfway.
meals.tip: Chicken thighs are juicier and cheaper than breasts. At 425°F everything crisps up perfectly without getting soggy.

meals.name: Whole Foods Wild Salmon Bowl
walmart: 365 by WFM Wild Sockeye Salmon (5oz fillet)
365 by WFM Brown Rice (1 cup cooked)
meals.steps: Cook rice. Pan-sear salmon in sesame oil 4 min per side. Sauté broccolini with tamari and ginger. Build bowl.
meals.tip: Wild sockeye salmon from Whole Foods has much higher omega-3 content than farmed Atlantic salmon. Worth the extra cost for the real health benefits.

meals.name: Kind Bar + Cheese
walmart: Kind Dark Chocolate Nuts & Sea Salt (1 bar)
meals.steps: Eat both.
meals.tip: Kind bars have real recognizable ingredients - you can see every nut. The combination of fiber from the bar and protein from cheese is a perfect maintenance snack.

meals.name: Apple with Trader Joe's Almond Butter
walmart: Trader Joe's Raw Almond Butter (2 tbsp)
meals.steps: Slice apple, dip in almond butter.
meals.tip: TJ's Raw Almond Butter is made from one ingredient and is about $4 - half the price of the same thing at Whole Foods.

recomp.label: Recomposition
recomp.description: Protein-forward meals that fit a modest calorie target while you train consistently.

meals.name: Fage + Protein + Berries
walmart: Fage Total 0% Greek Yogurt (7oz, Costco sells 4-packs)
ON Gold Standard Whey (1/2 scoop stirred in)
meals.steps: Stir half scoop of whey into yogurt until mixed. Top with thawed blueberries and walnuts.
meals.tip: Stirring protein powder into Greek yogurt gives you a thick, pudding-like texture with 35g protein. Fage is the thickest Greek yogurt on the market.

meals.name: High-Protein Egg Muffins Meal Prep
walmart: Great Value Liquid Egg Whites (1/2 cup)
meals.steps: Preheat 350°F. Whisk eggs and whites. Stir in sausage, peppers, cheese. Pour into greased 12-cup muffin tin. Bake 20-22 min.
meals.tip: Makes 12 egg muffins at once. Refrigerate up to 5 days. Microwave 30 sec per muffin. Two muffins = a complete high-protein breakfast.

meals.name: StarKist Tuna + Avocado Bowl
walmart: StarKist Tuna Creations BOLD Jalapeño (2.6oz pouch, Target)
meals.steps: Mix tuna with mashed avocado and lime. Serve in romaine leaves like boats. Top with tomatoes and seasoning.
meals.tip: StarKist Tuna Creations come pre-seasoned - no mayo needed. The jalapeño variety has zero added fat and exceptional flavor.

meals.name: Ground Turkey Zucchini Boats
meals.steps: Halve zucchini lengthwise, scoop seeds. Brown turkey with onion and taco seasoning. Fill zucchini, top with tomato sauce and cheese. Bake 400°F 20 min.
meals.tip: Replacing taco shells or tortillas with zucchini boats cuts carbs dramatically while adding fiber and potassium.

meals.name: Trader Joe's Shrimp Stir Fry
walmart: TJ's Frozen Asian Vegetable Blend (2 cups)
meals.steps: Sauté garlic in sesame oil. Add veggies, stir fry 4 min. Add shrimp and Soyaki, toss 2 min. Serve over rice.
meals.tip: Shrimp is the highest protein-per-calorie animal protein - 23g protein per 100 calories. TJ's frozen shrimp thaws in 10 min under cold water.

meals.name: Baked Cod & Roasted Cauliflower
walmart: Wild Caught Cod Fillet (5oz, WFM fresh counter or Costco frozen)
meals.steps: Toss cauliflower in olive oil and garlic powder, roast at 425°F 20 min. Season cod with dill and lemon, bake 400°F 12-15 min. Serve with capers on fish.
meals.tip: Cod is the leanest whitefish - almost zero fat with 20g protein per 3oz. Perfect for recomp when you want maximum protein minimum calories.

meals.name: Cottage Cheese Power Bowl
walmart: Kirkland Frozen Pineapple Chunks (1/4 cup, thawed)
meals.steps: Combine cottage cheese with thawed pineapple. Top with walnuts and cinnamon.
meals.tip: Cottage cheese before bed is one of the best recomp strategies - casein protein digests slowly over 7-8 hours, feeding muscle repair all night.

meals.name: Kirkland Protein Bar + Coffee
meals.steps: Eat bar, drink coffee.
meals.tip: Combining a protein bar with black coffee before a workout gives you caffeine for performance and amino acids for muscle protein synthesis simultaneously.
